spans.s:
पिल्^1 {c10c} U. (पेलयति-ते)
1 To
throw, cast.
--2 To send, direct.
--3
To incite, prompt.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170131. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/335. note: it's a verb; lost virama.

पील् {c1c} P. (पीलति)
1 To check,
obstruct, hinder.
--2 To stop.
--3
become stupid.

पीलुः [पील्-उ]
1 An arrow.
--2
An atom.
--3 An insect.
--4 An
elephant.
--5 The stem of the palm.
--6
A flower.
--7 A group of palm trees.
--8 A kind of tree.
--9 A heap of
bones.
--10 The central part of the
hand.
--लु n. The fruit of the Pīlu
tree
--Comp.
--पत्रः the Mūrvā plant.
--पर्णी {1} a kind of drug. {2} N. of
two plants.
--पाकवादिन् m. a
Vaiśeshika (one who maintains the
doctrine that heat acts only on the
atoms of matter, as of a jar, and not
on the whole body).

पिल्ल a. Blear-eyed.
--ल्लं A
bleared eye.
